metadata.title: Chapter 1: A New Beginning
metadata.author: Your Junior
metadata.description: The first day at a new school. Everything feels fresh and exciting.

lines.text: The morning sun filters through the curtains as you wake up. Today is the first day at your new school.
You quickly get ready and head out the door. The campus is bigger than you expected.

lines.speaker: alice
lines.text: Oh! You must be the new student! I'm Alice. Welcome to our school!

lines.speaker: alice
lines.text: Do you need help finding your classroom? I'd be happy to show you around!

choices.text: No thanks, I'll figure it out myself.
Only if you promise to be my guide for the whole day.

lines.speaker: alice
lines.text: Great! Your classroom is on the second floor. Follow me!

lines.speaker: alice
lines.text: Oh... okay. Well, if you change your mind, I'm usually in the library during lunch.

lines.speaker: alice
lines.text: W-what?! You're... you're something else, you know that?
You walk with Alice through the bustling hallways. She points out the cafeteria, the library, and the rooftop access.
You wander the halls alone, eventually finding your classroom. The day passes without incident.

lines.speaker: bob
lines.text: Hey, Alice! Who's your friend here?

lines.speaker: bob
lines.text: Nice to meet you! I'm Bob. I run the cooking club. You should totally join us sometime!
You spend lunch with Alice and Bob. The food is great and the conversation is even better.
You eat lunch by yourself on a bench near the garden. It's peaceful, but you feel a bit lonely.
As the school bell rings, you realize this is just the beginning of something special.
